authorization: User requests incorporating the recent PR, an Ubuntu test on the local Proxmox host, committed GitHub changes and a downloadable release.
backup: Verified complete local Git bundle output/release-4.6.3/pre-publication.bundle; existing v4.6.2 tag/release/assets retained.
pushPolicy: Fast-forward main, annotated version tag, no force push. Preserve unrelated gxmetal.
publishGate: Upload draft, compare all asset names/sizes/SHA-256 digests, publish latest, independently fetch every asset anonymously.
rollback: If public verification fails, restore v4.6.2 as latest through release 445028007; retain v4.6.3 tag/assets for diagnosis.
scope: GitHub repository/tag/release only; public guest catalog and website unchanged.
